lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly vertical columns of 3 to 5 units, positioned posterior to the gill slits and continuing along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with higher intensity on the dorsal edge and shadowing on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 7-9 high-luminance blobs are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, distributed primarily along the central and lower portions of the fin surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct horizontal linear feature of low pixel intensity is visible crossing the middle of the first dorsal fin, suggestive of a healed scar or persistent mark.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several commensal organisms (remoras) attached to the mid-flank and near the branchial region.
